channel.title: Hermes News Briefing

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: September inflation report expected to show renewed price pressure
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Economists expect U.S. CPI to rise 0.6% month-over-month and 3.6% year-over-year, driven largely by gasoline and food costs; the report lands just before the Fed’s late-October meeting and the midterm election stretch. [1] [2]

Sources: [1] [2]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

U.S. regulators said the bank violated Bank Secrecy Act obligations and failed to report priority national-security risks, including Chinese money-laundering networks and illicit finance along the southwest border. [3]

Sources: [3]

item.description:

Section: 🇺🇸 US News

item.description:

item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Austin weighs water-use rules for large data centers
item.description:
Section: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX

Austin Water is considering conservation plans, annual reporting, water budgets and possibly closed-loop cooling requirements for facilities using more than 85 million gallons a year. The proposal matters as AI/data-center growth collides with Central Texas water constraints. [7]

Sources: [7]

item.title: 📍 Austin / Round Rock TX: Taylor approves 664-acre data-center campus with on-site power

Taylor City Council unanimously approved a development agreement for the Taylor Technology Campus, a 664-acre data-center project with on-site power generation, closed-loop reclaimed-water cooling and $28.2 million in local commitments. Supporters cite tax revenue and school funding; opponents warn about water, gas generation and community impacts. [8]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India delays UPI merchant fee until after Diwali
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

NPCI postponed a planned 0.4% fee on UPI merchant transactions above ₹2,000 until after the festival season. The delay gives retailers and payment firms more time to prepare for the first major move away from zero-cost UPI payments in years. [9]

Sources: [9]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: India may need far more coal power as demand surges
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

India’s power-sector planner said coal additions could rise beyond the earlier 97 GW plan, possibly by 105-150 GW, as electricity demand runs sharply above last year and hydropower output falls. The shift underscores India’s grid-reliability challenge despite rapid renewable additions. [10]

Sources: [10]

item.title: 🇮🇳 India News: Indian protest leaders detained amid voter-roll dispute
item.description:
Section: 🇮🇳 India News

Leaders of India’s “cockroach” movement were detained for five days, Reuters reported, amid protests over voter-list revisions and calls for election chief Gyanesh Kumar to resign. The dispute could become a bigger political flashpoint as opposition groups and student bodies organize daily demonstrations. [11]

Sources: [11]

Section: 🌍 International / World

Sources: [19]

Section: 💼 Business / Markets

ASML said AI-driven demand for chipmaking equipment is so strong it will not fully meet customer demand in 2027 or 2028, even after planned capacity increases. The comments reinforce that semiconductor supply-chain bottlenecks remain a limiting factor for the AI buildout. [20]

Sources: [20]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Kroger to cut 3,000 corporate jobs as it leans into AI
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Kroger plans to eliminate about 3,000 corporate roles over three years while investing in AI and operational streamlining. The layoffs show how large legacy retailers are using automation and restructuring to protect margins in a tougher grocery market. [21]

Sources: [21]

item.title: 💼 Business / Markets: Markets stabilize but oil and CPI risks keep pressure on equities
item.description:
Section: 💼 Business / Markets

Asian shares edged higher as AI-linked chip stocks recovered from a selloff, but elevated Brent and U.S. crude prices plus pending CPI data kept investors cautious. The market remains caught between AI optimism, energy inflation and Fed-rate uncertainty. [22]

Sources: [22]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Bank of America hit with $1.2B money-laundering penalty
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

U.S. regulators fined Bank of America $1.21 billion, saying it failed to report more than $5 billion in suspicious activity, including transactions tied to national-security and sanctions risks. The penalty will cut third-quarter earnings and signals tougher enforcement against large-bank compliance failures. [1] [2]

Sources: [1] [2]

item.title: 🇺🇸 US News: Gas and food prices expected to lift U.S. inflation
item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [3]

item.description:
Section: 🇺🇸 US News

Sources: [4]

item.description:
Section: 🤖 AI & Tech Breakthroughs

The proposal argues voluntary commitments are insufficient for frontier models with external-network or cyber capabilities. [15]
